register.p: {{SHORT}} answers can take a while. In ~/.codex/config.toml, add tool_timeout_sec = 300 under the [mcp_servers.{{SERVER}}] table the command created. If codex mcp list already shows {{SERVER}}, ask the user before replacing it.

confirm.p: It should list {{SERVER}}. Codex loads MCP servers at startup, so tell the user to restart Codex.
